title: formatTime
responsibility: Formats recorded instants consistently while retaining calendar labels and missing-value fallbacks.

inputs.name: formatTime.instant
inputs.description: Recorded instant to format; null uses the fallback.

inputs.name: formatTime.fallback
inputs.description: Text for missing or invalid instants. Defaults to the original instant or Unknown when null.

inputs.name: formatTime.style
inputs.description: Optional format: compact medium date/short time, the default, or full platform date/time.

inputs.name: timeLabel.recorded
inputs.description: Recorded timestamp, calendar label or date-only text.

inputs.name: displayTime.instant
inputs.description: Recorded revision instant, or null when unavailable.

outputs.name: formatTime
outputs.description: Localized instant or the supplied fallback.

outputs.name: timeLabel
outputs.description: Localized timestamp; other text and invalid timestamps stay unchanged.

outputs.name: displayTime
outputs.description: Localized revision instant, or Unknown when missing or invalid.
